title: Unreal Quality & Silhouette!
comment: The 260 GSM corduroy fabric feels ultra-premium. Boxy fit is literally perfect, no awkward sagging. Worth every rupee.

title: Top Tier Streetwear in India
comment: Screen print texture is subtle and artisan stitching is on point. Got so many compliments in college!

title: The Stacking is Insane
comment: Best flared baggy pants on the market right now. Pair them with any chunky sneakers and you are set.

title: Super warm, heavy drape
comment: Fabric weight is legit 450+ GSM. Zipper is YKK quality. Took 4 days for shipping to Chandigarh, but worth the wait.

title: Solid Stainless Steel weight
comment: Does not tarnish or rust even with daily sweat and shower. The spear carving has sharp gothic detail.
